# Cyber Swap — Swap on Cyber L2 Reference

> Trade ETH, USDC and tokens on Cyber — an EVM Ethereum layer 2 in the CyberConnect ecosystem — through a non-custodial decentralized exchange. Independent, not affiliated with Cyber or CyberConnect.

## Key Facts
- Cyber: EVM-compatible Ethereum layer 2 built on the OP Stack (Optimism Superchain), tied to the CyberConnect social/identity ecosystem
- Gas: paid in ETH on Cyber
- Custody: non-custodial — swaps settle through public smart contracts; wallet signs
- Costs: DEX pool fee + network gas (ETH) + price impact; ERC-20 spend needs a one-time approval
- Common pairs: ETH <-> USDC / USDT and other tokens with on-chain liquidity
- Interpretation: "Cyber Swap" is treated as swapping on the Cyber L2 generally, not a single named product
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Cyber or CyberConnect
